# Authentication

Provider: `jwt`.

## Endpoints

| Operation | Path |
| --- | --- |
| `login` | `/api/auth/login` |
| `me` | `/api/auth/me` |
| `logout` | `/api/auth/logout` |

## Session storage

`server-cookie` — the token lives in an `HttpOnly; Secure` cookie named `axiomkit_session`, set by your login route. Script cannot read it, so an XSS cannot exfiltrate the session.

## Routes

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Login page | `/login` |
| After login | `/dashboard` |
| After logout | `/login` |
| Public routes | `/login`, `/api/auth` |

## Environment

| Variable | Used by | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `JWT_SECRET` | middleware, `getServerSession` | Server-only. Keep it in `admin.server.ts`, never in `admin.config.ts`. |

## The login route

With `server-cookie` storage the browser never sees the token — your login
route sets it:

```ts
// app/api/auth/login/route.ts
import { sessionCookie } from '@cortejojicoy/admin-kit/server'

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const token = await signInAgainstYourBackend(await request.json())
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }), {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Set-Cookie': sessionCookie(token, { name: 'axiomkit_session', maxAge: 60 * 60 * 8 }),
    },
  })
}
```
